newsitem.title: USA: Elderly motorist veers into gymnasium, killing one.
newsitem.headline: Elderly motorist veers into gymnasium, killing one.

text.p: An elderly motorist lost control of her car and careened through the double doors of a YMCA gymnasium Friday, killing one basketball player who was taking a break, police said.

The driver, 76-year-old Mary Roberts, was among the seven people injured in the accident at the Jordan YMCA, and was taken to a hospital with facial cuts, Marion County Sheriff's spokesman Scott Minier said.
Adam Miller, 26, was standing inside a set of double-doors watching when Roberts' car veered through the YMCA's parking lot and smashed through the doors, killing him.
Minier said it was not known how Roberts lost control of the car. He said the toll could have been higher.
"There were two full-court basketball games going on when she came through. Fortunately somebody had just scored (in one game) and everybody ran to the other end of the court," Minier said.
